owner: CC owns the test fixes. Akien owns the sole-path architectural decision (librarian through db_domain) and the two missing charters (cairnhelp, whatsnext).
intention: The test suite carries 9 remaining failures after the fixture build (commit 51a557c). Four are test-code fixes (diagnostic/device_logs_unwired test classes derive an unintended component name; aider_shim interceptor test does not account for the system-prompt insertion; moreabout duplicate test sends a different string from its prior deposit). Three are live-data assertions about the corpus (harbor_master clearance hardcodes a ticket that is no longer riding; watchme_spec reds on three tickets carrying WATCHME without a spec; intent_skill derivation gate reds on cairnhelp skill and whatsnext command having no charter). Two are the known sole-path debt (librarian imports psycopg2 directly, caught by both import_sieve and db_domain sole_path).
why: MEASURED 2026-08-20. 1459 passed, 9 failed, 0 errors. The fixture build (51a557c) resolved 44 failures from missing pytest fixtures and exposed the residual 9 — each with a distinct root cause. A red test suite that stays red stops being a signal.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured. The 9 are measured, root-caused, and categorized.
Law 9 — red is the default; green is earned. Each fix earns its own green.
Law 8 — nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build could not pass. The fixes restore what the proofs were built to measure.
gates: (1) The four test-code fixes restore the proofs to measure what they were written to measure. (2) The three live-data fixes update the corpus to match its own constraints. (3) The sole-path debt is noted as an IOU — it requires routing librarian's psycopg2 through db_domain, which is an architectural change.
falsifier: RED if: (1) any fixed test can pass on a build that reintroduces its original defect; (2) a corpus fix invents state rather than correcting it; (3) the sole-path fix introduces a second abstraction layer when db_domain already provides the door.
horizon: Immediate — the test fixes unblock all other work that depends on a green suite.
watchme: none, because the test-suite cleanup has no efficacy question a probe could answer — its proof IS the measurement (the suite is green or it is not)
